total_debt.description: Carrying amount of current plus noncurrent debt and finance leases; excludes operating leases and sale-leaseback financing liabilities.

capex.description: Positive cash expenditures for flight plus ground equipment; excludes equity investments and company non-GAAP adjustments.

ebitda.description: GAAP operating income plus depreciation and amortization. Unadjusted operating EBITDA proxy; excludes rent addback. Requires definition review.

unrestricted_cash.description: Cash-flow total less separately disclosed current and noncurrent restricted cash, reconciled to balance-sheet cash. Requires availability review.
